Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component

Class MaterialInstances

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component.MaterialInstances
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockComponent
@BedrockFormat("1.19.40") public final class MaterialInstances extends Object implements BlockComponent
The material instances for a block. Maps face or material_instance names in a geometry file to an actual material instance. Material instance can either be a full material instance or a name to another already defined instance. Limited to 64 instances.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:material_instances". Compiled by the hand transform Transforms.materialInstances.

Since:
1.0.0
